scope: Standalone 48-query initial-background derivative audit. All original288/cap10000 failures remain frozen; normalized run is independent. No evolution/production or universal stability claim.
early_weight_guard_note: 36 old plans cleared weights before separate audits, so their physical/coefficient contributions are not reconstructed or relabeled.
normalization_conclusion: Raw background-coefficient L1 is not invariant to scaling a nuisance basis column; it cannot alone establish intrinsic stability. Do not relabel old failures or relax physical/rank/condition/reproduction gates.
next_guard_gate: Use physical functional amplification and measured physical-source/noise sensitivity, dimensionless basis/reproduction diagnostics, and sensitivity to independent background-jet uncertainty. A raw coefficient becomes meaningful only together with an invariant bound on the corresponding background uncertainty. Complete transition geometry coverage and matched nonspherical/profile tests remain required before adoption.
